name: Wasurenagusa
source:
Main character becomes manager of the dormitory. Cleaning, washing and cooking are among his responsibilities. Is it possible for dormitory to fall in love? And to have a date?

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/06/vn-of-month-august-2007-ninkyou-hana.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主人公成为宿舍管理员。打扫、洗衣和做饭都属于他的职责。宿舍里也能产生爱情吗？能约会吗？

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/06/vn-of-month-august-2007-ninkyou-hana.html]vndbreview[/url]]
